header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “When a servant commits a sin and then (in regret) says, “O my Lord! I have sinned. Forgive me!', Allah says to the angels, “Does My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives sins, who both punishes for sins and forgives them? I have forgiven My servant!” Then, for as long as Allah Ta'ala wills, he keeps away from sin. Then he again commits a sin and (in regret) says, “O my Lord! I have committed another sin! Forgive that too!' Then Allah says to the angels, “Does My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives sins, who both punishes for sins and forgives them? I have forgiven My servant.' Then, for as long as Allah Ta'ala wills, he kept away from committing sin; again he commits some sin and (in regret) says, “O Lord! I have committed a sin again, forgive that too!' When he says this, Allah says, “Does My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives sins, who both punishes for sins and forgives them?” “I have forgiven My servant a third time as well; now let him do as he wishes (each time, if he makes Tawbah after the sin, I will accept his Tawbah).” This is what Allah Ta'ala says to the angels.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُمِّ عِصْمَةَ الْعَوْصِيَّةِ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِﷺ: مَامِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَعْمَلُ ذَنْباً إِلَّا وَقَفَ الْمَلَكُ الْمَُؤَكَّلُ بِإِحْصَاءِ ذُنُوبِهِ
